== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Son Of Skywalker (V)#Source formats|Son Of Skywalker (V) (Errata)]]: the PC card image of [[Son Of Skywalker (V)]] (30 December 2024, [[:File:V24-L-sonofskywalker-PC-E1.png|V24-L-sonofskywalker-PC-E1.png]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (page 2). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-6/68/V24-L-sonofskywalker-2025-02-02-sheet-changes.png Internet Archive item].
